title: Artifacts v0.3.0
description: Versioned named outputs - named, versioned binary/text outputs produced by an agent run. Distinct from memory stores (retrieval-oriented) and workspace (mutable scratch FS). Artifacts are immutable once written: each write produces a new version; older versions are preserved.

scope.description: session: artifact visible only within current session; user: artifact visible across sessions for same user; agent: artifact visible across all sessions for this agent

path_prefix.description: Storage path prefix; absent = no prefix

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds; absent = no expiry

versioned.description: If true, each write increments version counter; if false, latest write overwrites
